sources_used.source: Google Maps (visitor view; results filtered to the Piscataway Township boundary polygon from OSM/Nominatim)
Piscataway Township official business directory (Piscataway Business Partnership members)
ACEC New Jersey member directory (Omsum Engineering)
Carrier/agency finder directories (Liberty Mutual, Progressive, Plymouth Rock, State Farm) for Piscataway agencies
Web search results across category + Piscataway queries (company sites, WhereOrg, LawyerDB, Yellow Pages snippets, Procore, DesignRush)

categories_thin: Title agencies - only 2 found in town; most Central Jersey title agencies are in Edison/New Brunswick
Land surveying - only 1 Piscataway-based firm; surveyors commonly work out of nearby towns
Architecture - only 2 confirmed; several architecture offices use Edison or New Brunswick addresses
Environmental consulting - 1 found (Sage ATC); most environmental firms here are larger multi-office consultancies
Appraisal - 2 found; many appraisers are sole practitioners with no public office listing
Staffing - 5 independent firms found; national chains (Randstad, Aerotek, Kelly) also have Piscataway offices but are excluded as chains
caveats: Google Maps list view returned about 11-22 results per query, so many narrow category queries were used (accountant, tax preparer, bookkeeper, law firm, attorney, insurance agency, independent insurance agent, financial advisor, mortgage broker, real estate agency, property management, commercial real estate, appraiser, title company, engineering, architecture, surveyor/environmental, staffing, IT services, software company, marketing agency, business consultant). Businesses that Maps returns only under a keyword not tried may be missing.

Every map result was filtered by point-in-polygon against the OpenStreetMap boundary of Piscataway Township, so nearby Edison/New Brunswick/South Plainfield listings that appear in results were dropped unless they were listed at a Piscataway address in a directory.

Excluded as national/regional chains or brand franchises: H&R Block, TurboTax offices, B. Riley Wealth, State Farm/Allstate/Nationwide/Travelers agency offices, CMIT Solutions, RE/MAX Home Pros, Coldwell Banker, ERA Boniakowski, Randstad, Aerotek, Kelly Services/Educational Staffing, uBreakiFix, AECOM, Virtusa, Synechron, Digital Realty, plus banks and credit unions.
Google Maps list rows do not expose outbound website URLs (only redirect links), so websites are blank for most map-only entries; the triage team will need to look them up.

Several map listings show phone numbers with non-local area codes (Michigan, Iowa, Wisconsin, San Diego, NY) - common for staffing/consulting branch offices and possibly mobile numbers; flagged in notes.

Where an office building hosts many small consulting/IT firms (15 Corporate Place South, 371 Hoes Lane, 30 Knightsbridge Rd, 200 Centennial Ave), several listings there may be virtual/registered offices rather than staffed suites - verify before outreach.
data_gaps: Yellow Pages, BBB, Justia, Manta, AllPages, Cylex, ChamberofCommerce.com all returned HTTP 403 / Cloudflare bot checks to both fetch and the headless browser, so those bulk directories could not be mined.
Overpass API (OpenStreetMap) was unreachable (timeouts and HTTP 504 from three mirrors), so no OSM cross-check of office=* features in the township.
Piscataway Township does not publish a licensed-business list online; only the opt-in Piscataway Business Partnership directory is available.
Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce Piscataway directory page loaded but rendered essentially empty (likely JavaScript/member-login gated).

njbusinessdirectory.org lists 169 Piscataway businesses including ~15 professional services and ~14 computers/IT, but its category filter did not apply and its visible page skews to home/retail trades, so those listings were not captured.
njbusinessdirectory.org, NJTGO and the township directory give no phone numbers for several member entries (marked Unknown).
